# archestra_blob_provider (Resource)

Object storage destination that features such as cost exports write files to (API 1.5.0-rc.30 or later). Set exactly one of `s3`, `gcs` or `azure_blob`. By default the API writes and deletes a small test object before saving; set `skip_connection_test` to save without it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An S3 bucket the platform reaches with its own AWS credential chain.
resource "archestra_blob_provider" "finops" {
  name = "FinOps exports"

  s3 = {
    bucket      = "acme-finops"
    region      = "us-east-1"
    key_prefix  = "archestra"
    auth_method = "default_chain"
  }
}

# Google Cloud Storage with a service account key. Credentials are write-only:
# the API never returns them, and removing them clears the stored key.
resource "archestra_blob_provider" "gcs" {
  name = "Billing bucket"

  gcs = {
    bucket      = "acme-billing"
    auth_method = "service_account_key"
  }

  credentials = {
    serviceAccountKey = var.gcs_service_account_key
  }
}

variable "gcs_service_account_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `azure_blob` (Attributes) Azure Blob Storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_blob))
- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive) Write-only static credentials for the auth method: `accessKeyId`, `secretAccessKey` and optional `sessionToken` (S3 `access_key`); `serviceAccountKey` (GCS `service_account_key`); `clientSecret`, `accountKey` or `sasToken` (Azure). The API never returns them, so Terraform cannot detect out-of-band changes; removing the attribute clears the stored credentials.
- `gcs` (Attributes) Google Cloud Storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcs))
- `s3` (Attributes) Amazon S3 or an S3-compatible store. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3))
- `skip_connection_test` (Boolean) Save without first writing and deleting a test object. Applies to every create and update while set.

### Read-Only

- `has_credentials` (Boolean) Whether static credentials are stored for this provider.
- `id` (String) Blob provider UUID.
- `type` (String) Provider type: `s3`, `gcs` or `azure_blob`, from the block you set.

<a id="nestedatt--azure_blob"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_blob`

Required:

- `account_name` (String) Storage account name.
- `auth_method` (String) `default_credential`, `service_principal`, `account_key` or `sas_token`.
- `container` (String) Container name.

Optional:

- `client_id` (String) App registration client ID. Required for, and only allowed with, `service_principal`.
- `endpoint` (String) Blob service endpoint for sovereign clouds or Azurite; omit for `https://<account_name>.blob.core.windows.net`.
- `key_prefix` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket that every object is written under, without leading or trailing `/`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Entra tenant ID. Required for, and only allowed with, `service_principal`.


<a id="nestedatt--gcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcs`

Required:

- `auth_method` (String) `application_default` (the platform's credentials) or `service_account_key` (static `credentials`).
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.

Optional:

- `key_prefix` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket that every object is written under, without leading or trailing `/`.


<a id="nestedatt--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3`

Required:

- `auth_method` (String) `default_chain` (the platform's AWS credential chain), `access_key` (static `credentials`) or `assume_role`.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `region` (String) Bucket region, such as `us-east-1`.

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Custom endpoint for S3-compatible stores (MinIO, R2, Ceph); omit for AWS.
- `external_id` (String) External ID the role's trust policy requires. Only allowed with `assume_role`.
- `force_path_style` (Boolean) Path-style addressing, required by most S3-compatible stores.
- `key_prefix` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket that every object is written under, without leading or trailing `/`.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN to assume. Required for, and only allowed with, `assume_role`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing blob provider by UUID. Credentials are not imported; set
# them in configuration to replace the stored ones.
terraform import archestra_blob_provider.finops 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
